get.summary: Retrieve the saved credit card details for a customer.
get.description: This API endpoint is used to retrieve the saved credit card details for a specific customer.

parameters.name: pluginIdentifier
parameters.description: The code for the payment configuration set.

parameters.name: customerGuid
parameters.description: The unique identifier for the customer.

200.description: Success – Indicates that the request was successfully executed and returns the credit card details in the PaymentManagerCreditCardDetailsResponse model.

204.description: No Content – The customer exists in Payment Manager but has no active saved credit cards.

400.description: Bad Request – customerGuid is empty or is not a valid GUID.

404.description: Not Found – No payment method has been recorded in Payment Manager for the specified customerGuid.

500.description: Server Error – Indicates that an error occurred on the server while processing the request.
